subscriptions.err_bill_void.en: This subscription is void, so it bills nothing. Unvoid it in Documents to bill it again.

subscriptions.err_bill_not_active.en: Only an active subscription bills, and this one is not active. Revert it to draft in Documents, then activate it on its page.

subscriptions.err_agreement_activate.en: A draft subscription starts only with Activate on its own page, which sets its first bill date. Documents can void it, but not finalize or issue it.

subscriptions.err_agreement_status_lifec.en: A subscription is only ever draft, active, paused, cancelled or void. Change its status on its own page: activate, pause, resume or cancel it there. Documents can void it, unvoid it or revert it to draft.

subscriptions.runs_generation.en: Automatic billing runs now, authorized by {name}.

subscriptions.runs_sending.en: Each bill is emailed to the customer automatically, authorized by {name}.

subscriptions.runs_generation_lapsed.en: Automatic billing is on but does not run: {name}, who authorized it, no longer has permission to. Someone who does can turn it off and on again to authorize it.

subscriptions.runs_sending_lapsed.en: Automatic sending is on but does not run: {name}, who authorized it, no longer has permission to. Someone who does can turn it off and on again to authorize it.

subscriptions.runs_by_hand.en: Nothing runs automatically: bill each period from this page.

subscriptions.err_no_periods.en: {ref} is still a draft, so it has no billing periods yet. Activate it on this page to start its schedule.

subscriptions.err_status_void.en: {ref} is void, so its status cannot change here. Unvoid it in Documents first if it should run again.

subscriptions.err_bill_unscheduled.en: {ref} can't bill again. Its agreement {agreement} has schedule settings that don't make a schedule: {reason} Fix the schedule on the agreement first.

subscriptions.err_schedule_unreadable.en: This agreement's saved schedule can't be read. Set its schedule again on the agreement page.

subscriptions.err_send_in_progress.en: This email is being sent right now. Check again in a few minutes.

subscriptions.summary_send_sending.en: {ref} is being emailed right now. Check again in a few minutes.
